principle: The trust-agnostic seam: curated / community / discovered / experimental components coexist under GRADED sandboxing. The trust tier gates the EXECUTION environment and WHAT DATA may flow — not merely visibility. This is load-bearing, not a someday feature: running third-party code/servers at scale is a real security minefield (MCP's 2026 ecosystem alone: 30+ CVEs in two months, a cross-tenant leak, path-traversal, tool-poisoning). Deny-by-default: an unknown tier gets the most restrictive treatment. serves_truth=false.

tiers.note: manually verified (pymupdf, playwright, named model APIs) — full trust
crawler-found, unverified; HARD sandbox (gVisor/Firecracker/WASM), synthetic inputs only
user-uploaded custom; isolated; synthetic inputs only
